summary: San Francisco Bay Area resident, physics degree from a reputable state school, former rocket scientist, current software engineer at Asana, strong advocate for tech hiring reform, supporter of Triplebyte, interested in affordable housing and urban development, engaged in discussions about diversity in tech, family-oriented with aspirations for homeownership, critical of traditional hiring practices in tech, enjoys discussing software engineering and programming languages, particularly Julia, interested in machine learning and data science, values work-life balance and meaningful work over high compensation, identifies as Indian-American, concerned about social issues and housing affordability.
